package.name: burgerbot_perception
package.description: Camera-based object detection and semantic mapping for the burgerbot. object_detector runs a quantized TFLite model on the D435's color stream; object_projector uses the aligned depth image to turn each 2D detection into a 3D position in the map frame; semantic_map clusters the resulting stream into a small set of persistent, labelled objects and publishes them as RViz markers, saved/loaded alongside the SLAM map. Entirely additive -- none of navigation, localization, or exploration depends on this package existing.
